name: Dalin's Heart
summary: Near the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest, Dalin Forgewright patrols with an honorable heart.

sections.title: A Pure Heart for Dark Arts
sections.body: Undercity warlocks seek hearts from truly virtuous mortals to call and bind a succubus to their service. Dalin Forgewright spends his days defending desperate Lordaeron refugees kept from safety by the sealed Greymane Wall. His selfless devotion marks him as a rare offering of unblemished purity, and his heart is carved for the rites held in the Temple of the Damned.

faq.answer: Dalin Forgewright was an honorable human who protected Lordaeron refugees stranded outside the closed gates of the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why do warlocks need Dalin's Heart?
aliases: why do warlocks want dalin's heart
faq.answer: Undercity warlocks use Dalin's Heart as a ritual lure to draw a succubus, then bind her to their service.
Carendin Halgar, a warlock trainer in the Temple of the Damned within the Undercity, accepts Dalin's Heart.

faq.q: What other component is needed alongside this heart?
aliases: hearts of the pure other heart
faq.answer: Carendin Halgar requires Dalin's Heart and Comar's Heart. Comar Villard is a faithful husband wandering the Wetlands in search of his lost wife.

angles.text: As a Forsaken warlock, you undergo this rite of passage to learn to ensnare a succubus, harvesting untainted virtue for demonic mastery.
As an undead, you see the bitter reality of post-Scourge Lordaeron, where living human altruists outside the Greymane Wall become prey for the Forsaken.
